note: What each duty's two action scenes SHOW. The briefs in prompts/ are about shape, camera, palette and register -- they are the same for every duty. This is the part that differs, and it is kept here so the viewfinder and the art board fill in the same words rather than each carrying their own copy.
filling: A duty with nothing written down yet is absent from `duties` rather than present and empty, so a page can tell 'nobody has decided' from 'deliberately blank' and say so. One dash per line, in the order they matter.

clerical.left:
- a lone monk prostrate on the flagstones
- beneath a vast dark crucifix
- in an austere gothic nave
- with one guttering candle
clerical.right:
- a hard-faced medieval smith
- striking a coin die with a hammer
- a heavy working surface
- a compact forge or charcoal fire
- an armed medieval man watching from the shadow behind him

ordination.left:
- an ordination procession at the west door of a parish church
- a bishop with crook and mitre laying his hand on a kneeling barefoot man on the
  worn church steps
- behind them a short file of monks with a cross-bearer and two candle-bearers,
  coming out of the dark doorway into the grey daylight
- the church wall rising behind, its roof line level where it crosses the centre
- worn steps and trodden churchyard ground underfoot
ordination.right:
- two friars who have come down the road from that church, preaching at the edge of
  a poor hamlet
- one with his hands raised, the other carrying a satchel and a staff
- a gaunt family at the half-shut door of a turf-and-wattle hovel, wary and closed off
- broken cobbles, mud, a fence of stakes, a barrel, weeds at the wall foot
- a crow on the hovel roof and one bare branch above
